findings.title: The lower sections leave the right half of the page empty

location.description: The three sections below the hero, from the wheel to the shelf, studios that teach, and the price.

findings.viewer_experience: The page leans to the left after the hero. The eye reads down a narrow column while half the width stays empty.

current.value: Text fills the left half of each lower section and the right half is blank.

findings.target: The right half of each lower section holds something, or the content uses the full width.
findings.fix_direction: Use the width of each section: rebalance the content across it or give the empty side a purpose.
findings.source: Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Graphic Design (use of the grid)

closed_when.check: Looking at the three lower sections, none leaves its right half empty.

findings.title: The two plans have no way to choose them

location.description: The two price columns at the foot of the page.

findings.viewer_experience: A visitor who has decided on a plan finds nothing to press and must scroll back to the top.

current.value: Plan names, prices and a line of text, with no button or link.

findings.target: Each plan leads to a next step.
findings.fix_direction: Add one clear action to each plan.
findings.source: Nielsen Norman Group, call to action guidance

closed_when.check: Looking at the plans, each has an action.
